messages:
Aisha - Heads up: prepping QBR for Zenrata next Wed. Noticing a sharp token increase last 30d, want to lock in forecast + mitigation before the meeting. Can finance and eng weigh in?

billing-bot - Alert: Customer Zenrata daily token spend $12,300 (↑85% WoW). Dashboard: https://redwood.app/billing/zenrata :eyes:

Tom - Yikes. Do we have top drivers? embeddings, search, lots of streaming?

Aisha - Major drivers: embeddings index rebuild + a new analytics job that runs full-corpus embeddings daily, and increased streaming for chat sessions after feature launch. Also noticed high reranking traffic on /v1/rerank.

Priya - For immediate wins: enable prefix/KV caching on the chat route, reduce embedding job frequency to incremental, and use batching for their rerank calls. Redwood Optimize already has suggestions for their workload — I can export the exact config.

Jorge - Can we get a 30/60/90-day spend forecast if behavior continues vs. after mitigation? Need numbers for finance and to assess renewal risk. I can run the baseline projection if someone shares current daily averages by route.

Maya - Onboarding update: engineering said they haven't yet shipped client-side prefix caching (blocked on a small SDK bug). ETA end of week if we prioritize.

Tom - Suggest we also enable a temporary token cap + budget alert to prevent surprise overage. Something like: 
```json
{
  "budget_threshold": 0.8,
  "token_cap": 2000000,
  "notification": ["email", "slack"]
}
```
Set the cap conservatively, communicate to product team first.

support-bot - Budget alert created: cap=2,000,000 tokens/day, notify=@Aisha,@Tom,@Jorge. Will throttle non-critical routes if hit.

Aisha - Thanks. Jorge, I pasted the per-route daily averages in the shared sheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/zenrata-qbr (rows: chat, embeddings, rerank, analytics).

Jorge - Got it — I'll run the projection and post numbers by EOD tomorrow. Will include two scenarios: current trajectory and after implementing caching+batching.

Priya - I'll schedule a 45-min enablement session for the Zenrata eng and product leads to walk through caching, batching, and model selection (quantization where applicable). Also have a short cost-playbook slide deck here: https://redwood.app/playbooks/cost-optimizations (will tailor before the QBR). :thumbsup:

Tom - Also flagging reserved capacity quote — if they move heavy embedding work to a dedicated pool we can drop effective per-token cost. Priya/Jorge, can you draft a ballpark? This could reduce renewal risk.

Priya - Will pull a delta between hosted unit cost vs. reserved (monthly commit) and share numbers tomorrow.

Aisha - Action items: (1) Jorge: projection by EOD tomorrow, (2) Priya: config + playbook + reserved-cost delta, (3) Maya/eng: prioritize client-side caching rollout, (4) Tom/Aisha: communicate temporary cap to customer and prep QBR slide. I'll collect everything into the QBR doc.

Tom - Sounds good. If cap causes any customer impact we can open a temporary exception for critical workflows.

Aisha - Thanks team. Adding a note to capture customer feedback: they asked for per-route cost granularity in console and clearer routing suggestions — I'll add to product backlog.

Priya - Noted for product. I'll attach a short eval to detect regressions when we switch models/quantization.

Aisha - 👍
